lead_headline: Mother Other opens vegan restaurant on Broadway while 1up Arcade Bar closes LoDo after 15 years

restaurant.blurb: 5 new leads today: Sabores De La preferida #2 (Arvada), Elotes El Bombon (Villa Park), Sadboy Creamery brick-and-mortar (Cheesman Park), Good Girl Cafe & Bookstore (Englewood), plus a Tacos Samy closure in Chaffee Park.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today — and none detected across the past 14 days. The liquor license pipeline has gone completely quiet, a notable departure from typical weekly activity. Database now tracks 12,325 licenses statewide with no recent movement on new bar, restaurant, or retail applications.
